mods.name: PickupPop
mods.description: Lightweight client-side pickup notifications for Minecraft 26.3. Unofficial port inspired by Pick Up Notifier by Fuzs (MPL-2.0) and the PickupPop adaptation. This is an unofficial port — all credit for the original concept, design, and logic goes to Fuzs and the original PickupPop author. Code updated to 26.3 by Itamio. See NOTICE for licensing details.
